notes.title: V0.6 Changelog - Sep 3, 2025 - New Fusion Mode + Item Wishlist + Red-Rarity Item
notes.content: [h1]New Fusion Mode Added[/h1][p align="justify"]New Fusion Mode is here! In Fusion Mode, players can select one Primary Supercat (which determines the hero’s appearance and basic traits), then choose one Secondary Supercat to fuse and inherit its traits onto the Primary Supercat. This way, a single Supercat can possess two sets of traits at once—these traits stack and take effect, significantly boosting the Supercat’s power! However, not all fusions will enhance a Supercat’s strength. We encourage you to experiment more and explore all possibilities with your Supercats![/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/ea128509677e4291d988f0f7f35ec8b01f83867d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/c4bc9c86bd6d370401d9f86edb724a9586893e90.png"][/img][/p][h3]Fusion Trait Rules[/h3][p align="justify"]In Fusion Mode, select a Primary Supercat—it defines the fused Supercat’s basic traits. Then, choose a Secondary Supercat to fuse with the Primary one. The active traits of the fused Supercat will be displayed in the trait panel at the top-right corner.[/p][p align="justify"]If the traits of the two Supercats conflict, the Primary Supercat’s traits take precedence. For example:[/p][p align="justify"]The Primary Supercat 【Doudle Guns】 can equip only 2 weapons.[/p][p align="justify"]The Secondary Supercat 【Mavericks】 can equip only 1 weapon.[/p][p align="justify"]In this trait conflict, the Primary’s 【Doudle Guns】 trait prevails—the fused Supercat can equip 2 weapons.[/p][p align="justify"]Testing all Supercat combinations in Fusion Mode involves enormous workloads, so there may be undiscovered potential bugs. If you encounter any bugs or issues, please contact us to provide feedback. We will fix or adjust them as soon as possible. Thank you for your support![/p][h3]Fusion Mode Seasons[/h3][p align="justify"]Fusion Mode shares the same season cycle as Survival Mode, and both modes benefit from the seasonal item enhancement bonuses.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][h1]New Fusion Mode Leaderboard[/h1][p align="justify"]A dedicated leaderboard for Fusion Mode has been added. Players can switch between leaderboards for different modes in the leaderboard interface. The Fusion Mode leaderboard displays the two fused Supercats used by players, as well as their survival time records.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/6005d13d4a43cb24c6e5b95668078b2cff2e7cda.png"][/img][/p][h1]New Item Wishlist Feature[/h1][p align="justify"]To address the community feedback that "core Build items are often unobtainable, harming gameplay experience," we have developed the Item Wishlist feature. This feature is now available in both Fusion Mode and Survival Mode:[/p][p align="justify"]Players can select 5 items to add to their Item Wishlist. These items are guaranteed to appear in the shop at specific waves. You can leverage your Supercat’s fused traits for targeted development, taking its power to the next level![/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/a9d22c6884fa80f96415b4784d1f92c009c50e89.png"][/img][/p][h1]New Red-Rarity Items[/h1][p align="justify"]15 new Red-Rarity Items have been added to Fusion Mode and Survival Mode. These items are randomly obtainable from chests dropped by defeating Bosses, and they provide powerful stat bonuses to Supercats![/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/d584bee62e0ad07cb84223921594563d5faef2a2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Main Menu UI Refresh[/h1][p align="justify"]As the game’s modes and system features have expanded, the original main menu layout has become somewhat cluttered. In this update, our art team has designed a new main menu UI, reorganizing the content and functions of the main menu. The new main menu also previews more modes that will be launched in the future. We hope this brings you a fresh experience![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/b9a06c97376443dcf1a2e908dcc229e3b595c24d.png"][/img][/p][h1]Adjustments & Optimizations[/h1][p align="justify"]1.Adjusted the effect of the item 【Stock】: After each wave, Harvest +8→+8%[/p][p align="justify"]2.The item 【Stock】 has been adjusted to be obtainable in both Fusion Mode and Survival Mode[/p][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][p]1.Fixed the issue where Supercats 【Monk Tang】【Wukong】【Nezha】 were not displayed on macOS systems[/p][p]2.Fixed the issue that controller vibration is triggered when an explosion occurs.[/p][p]3.Fixed a potential issue that could cause the game to freeze.[/p][p]4.Fixed the issue that the item \[Swamp] might reduce monster speed to 0.[/p][p][/p][h1]Previous Updates[/h1][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3415300/view/533232088948671321"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3415300/view/533231454521395189"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Season S3 Starts & New Mode Preview - Aug 26, 2025
notes.content:
[h1]Survival Mode Season 3 Starts[/h1][h2] Aug 26, 2025—Sep 16, 2025[/h2][p]Season S2 has come to a close, and Season S3 has already arrived! Thank you all for your enthusiastic participation—for repeatedly pushing the limits of Survival Mode, working together, and defending Meow-Star! However, the highlight of the recent period is the upcoming new mode, and we will provide a brief teaser.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/d14351de58c03f80cdc5ff579bd7fff4d360debd.png"][/img][/p][h2]Seasonal Hero Updates[/h2][p][b]【Lady】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/77e5bbe17bf2a19297266fa4db2e51410e329d3f.png"][/img][b]
【Farmer】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/6ff7bec713cd490b63e17653661d942427c1a791.png"][/img][b]
【Internet Celebrity】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/f3052e59266d407b15925c0b9d8fb80385eef8a8.png"][/img][/p][h2]Seasonal Item Updates[/h2][p][b]【Golden Toad】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/2ec800416d24b8c0885e442df2c6e73a32918604.png"][/img][b]
【Wallet】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/a02ab22fd058ab225ad7d294791a0db4bd00f945.png"][/img][b]
【Stock】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/1195248e325d6313f33701c2a0dcf9d112c4ed93.png"][/img][/p][h2]Seasonal Buff Updates[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/8415ef3647d562dee1baf5e9e0c6386d4329c569.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Fusion Mode Preview[/h1][p](Working in progress - Please refer to the official update for final content)[/p][p]After launching the Survival Mode last month, we wasted no time in starting development on a new mode—Fusion Mode. In this mode, players can select one primary Supercat (which defines the hero’s appearance and basic traits), then choose one secondary Supercat to fuse and inherit its traits onto the primary one. This way, a single Supercat can possess two sets of traits at once, and the two sets will stack and take effect, making the Supercat much more powerful! However, if you make an ill-suited fusion choice, it may well backfire and result in underwhelming traits. So, we encourage you to experiment more and explore all the possibilities with Supercats![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/827a0c104e91a21cee487447fcaa7e7b06e4768d.png"][/img][/p][p]Additionally, the Fusion Mode and Survival Mode will introduce an Item Wishlist Feature. For certain specific items, this feature will increase their drop rate. Players can leverage the fused traits of their Supercats for targeted development, taking their gameplay to the next level![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/1bc4af6a7e90d787886ff3b606a669d052f4a119.png"][/img][/p][h1]Preview Update[/h1][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3415300/announcements/detail/533232088948671322?snr=2___"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3415300/announcements/detail/533232088948671320"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3415300/announcements/detail/533231454521395190"][/dynamiclink][/p]

Welcome macOS users to join the battle to save the Meow Star![/p][p][/p][h1][b]New Heroes[/b][/h1][p]Added 6 new Supercat Heroes: [/p][p][b]【Internet Celebrity】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/f215ab3b9c993b9d66a6569bea3782ba90dd80db.png"][/img][/p][p][b]【Noble】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/1f2be37a63dccfc442be8af6f998ee0d603d333b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]【Sumo Wrestler】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/b35f44c7cba01b27152ca71eedfa4d82c36a676e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]【Hawkeye】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/0969a358f27a34d9db167f32b6a7e55ed5ff647e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]【Thug】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/c20b0230719c25ff5c7c7052cd59b150b25289b1.png"][/img][/p][p][b]【Man in Black】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/239d592aeb32799da5572bd9c678baec412f15aa.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]New Item[/b][/h1][p]New item [b]【Libra】[/b] added: When at full HP, picking up a healing gem or treasure chest increases max HP by 1 (maximum +10 per wave).[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Optimizations & Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]1. Optimized the heroes' visuals and display effects in the character selection interface.[/p][p]2. In the settings interface, adjusting monster speed will now also change the speed of bullets fired by monsters.[/p][p]3. In combat, the display of the number of treasure chests picked up has been changed to "treasure chest icon x number".[/p][p]4. In combat, the display of the number of hero level-up rewards has been changed to "level-up icon x number".[/p][p]5. Fixed a potential issue that could cause Survival Mode save data to be lost.[/p][p][/p][h1]Previous Updates[/h1][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3415300/view/533232088948671319"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3415300/view/533231454521395189"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: V0.5 Changelog - Aug 5, 2025 - Season 2 & Survival Mode Optimization Adjustments
notes.content:
[h1]Survival Mode Season 2 Launch[/h1][h3] (Aug 5, 2025—Aug 26, 2025)[/h3][p]The first season has come to a successful conclusion. Thank you all for your enthusiastic participation and your support and affection for us! At the same time, we have also received various opinions and suggestions from you regarding the gameplay of Survival Mode. In this update, we will also make optimization adjustments to Survival Mode to enhance the gaming experience of it! Thank you again for your support![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/573f59d4a6dc2c98261eb38218fa47256e46e7c3.png"][/img][/p][h1]Seasonal Hero Updates[/h1][p][b]【Big Guy】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/e4380d67ff799ff20900eee69ec7517fe5429d62.png"][/img][b]
【Merchant】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/a23dbbb35a2cbc95be4565a6814dc93e2f935893.png"][/img][b]
【Gentleman】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/33930f990eb20c9dd3baa527e7f21b567fde08aa.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Seasonal Item Updates[/h1][p][b]【Membership Card】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/9a57dc9ae487c3c93c62bd259f3ec5b28eb8562e.png"][/img][b]
【Space Suit】[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/a0e0d51e11f9ef1362238478888b88a68e25e338.png"][/img][b]
【Golden Toad】[/b][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/03fc422ef947b3a68f00f8c5b6a755a984460305.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Seasonal Buff Updates[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/e1876e6f482dcf2fa7396c57b354b66cd4d0bc3b.png"][/img][/p][p]This update focuses on balance adjustments for [b]【Survival Mode】[/b]. The core of these adjustments is to reduce the crystal output in Survival Mode and shorten the excessively long shopping time in the shop. At the same time, we will increase the harvest attribute values of some items and stop producing certain low return items. This aims to raise the drop probability of useful items and compensate for the reduced crystal output through these items, thereby making the gameplay experience of Survival Mode more smooth.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]【Survival Mode】Crystal Output Adjustment[/b][/h1][p]Based on player feedback and the development team’s testing evaluations, the current amount of crystals obtained in Waves 1-9 of Survival Mode is excessive. The long time spent purchasing items and weapons in the shop interface has negatively impacted the combat experience of Survival Mode. Therefore, we have decided to update the version when the first season ends, reducing the crystal output in Survival Mode by [b]40%[/b].[/p][p][/p][h1][b]【Survival Mode】Item Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]Due to the limited number of waves in Survival Mode, some items rarely achieve their intended effects after being obtained. Additionally, they occupy drop and randomization shares, reducing the drop chance of truly useful items. Therefore, we have decided to stop dropping certain items in Survival Mode and enhance the attributes of some others.[/p][list][*][p][b]Items no longer dropped in Survival Mode:[/b][/p][p][b]【Rocket Forging Hammer】【Membership Card】【Burning Cross】【Stock】【Headband】【Plastic Toys】【Battle Supply Box】[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Items with doubled harvest attributes or enhanced specific attributes:[/b][/p][p][b]【Gold Ore】[/b]: +35 → +70 Harvest, -8% Damage[/p][p][b]【Squirrel】[/b]: +10 → +20 Harvest, -3% Dodge, +20% Pickup Area[/p][p][b]【Mine Truck】[/b]: +15 → +30 Harvest, -1 Armor[/p][p][b]【Vending Machine】[/b]: +7 → +14 Harvest, -1 Melee[/p][p][b]【Honeycomb】[/b]: +4% Dodge, +5 → +10 Harvest, -1 Melee, -1 Ranged[/p][p][b]【Energy Mask】[/b]: Number of damage blocks per wave +1 → +3[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]【Survival Mode】Weapon Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]In Survival Mode, some weapons also have low returns on harvest attributes. The harvest attributes of the following weapons are doubled:[/p][p]White-quality 【Manipulator】: +3 → +6 Harvest[/p][p]Blue-quality 【Manipulator】: +6 → +12 Harvest[/p][p]Purple-quality 【Manipulator】: +9 → +18 Harvest[/p][p]Orange-quality 【Manipulator】: +18 → +36 Harvest[/p][p][/p][h1][b]【Survival Mode】Hero Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]Due to the limited number of waves in Survival Mode, the traits of some Supercat Heroes have low returns and fail to fully showcase their unique features. Therefore, we have decided to adjust the following heroes:[/p][p]【Worker】New trait added: +5% Damage per summon item[/p][p]【Wild Beast】Trait added: Lifesteal growth modification +50%[/p][p]【Scholar】Trait enhanced: +5% → +10% Damage per hero level[/p][p]【Farmer】Trait enhanced: +20 → +40 Harvest; Harvest +5% → +10% after each wave ends[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][p]1. Fixed the issue where monsters fail to spawn or spawn in insufficient numbers.[/p][p]2. Fixed the problem where some monsters remain displayed in red.[/p][p]3. Fixed the issue of abnormal behavior in certain monsters.[/p][p][/p][h1]Previous Updates[/h1][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3415300/view/533230820789331499"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3415300/view/533230442520774627"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3415300/view/520844922798998080"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: V0.4 Changelog - July 30, 2025 - New Encyclopedia & 6 New Heroes
notes.content: [h1]New Encyclopedia[/h1][p]Added an encyclopedia system for items, weapons, and heroes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/fdcedfac7dedefdfdc3fc9491c050b287ab3ab32.png"][/img][/p][h1]New Heroes[/h1][p]Added 6 Supercat heroes: Thousand-Handed Hero, Explosive Soldier, Farmer, King, Knight, and Thief.[/p][p][/p][h1]New Items[/h1][p]1. \[Modification Tools]: Technology +3; destroying totems will generate summon objects.[/p][p]2. \[Crystal Ball]: Armor -3; +2 Luck for every 1% Critical Hit.[/p][p][/p][h1]New Features[/h1][p]1. Added 18 in-game achievements and Steam achievements.[/p][p]2. Added a function in the settings interface to hide damage numbers.[/p][p]3. Added a function in the settings interface to hide hit effects.[/p][p]4. In matches, the item encyclopedia and the current quantity held in the current game can be viewed in the shop interface, pause interface, and settlement interface.[/p][p][/p][h1]Performance Improvement[/h1][p]Reorganized all resources, modified the operation loading method, improved game running efficiency, and resolved lag issues.[/p][p][/p][h1]Balance Adjustments[/h1][p]1. Increased the maximum dodge attribute of the Superat \[Boxer] from 60% to 80%.[/p][p]2. Adjusted the attributes of some monsters in the 10th wave of Survival Mode for certain heroes.[/p][p]3. Adjusted the judgment mechanism of \[Fury Heart] and similar items, changing it so that the additional kill effect is only triggered once per weapon attack; the additional kill effect will no longer trigger repeatedly.[/p][p][/p][h1]Optimizations and Adjustments[/h1][p]1. Added country code display to player rankings in the Survival Leaderboard.[/p][p]2. Reduced the volume of the \[High-Speed Rifle] sound effect.[/p][p]3. Lowered the unlock condition for Survival Mode: clear Normal Mode once (previously 3 times) on any difficulty.[/p][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][p]1. Fixed the issue where the weapon \[Golden Cudgel] did not switch attack modes.[/p][p]2. Fixed a bug that could cause monsters to get stuck.[/p]

notes.title: V0.3 Changelog - July 23, 2025 - Custom Difficulty Feature
notes.content: [h1]New Feature[/h1][p]Added custom difficulty functions in settings, allowing custom adjustment of monsters' health, damage, and speed.[/p][p][/p][h1]New Items[/h1][p]New item 【Heart of Iron】: -6% attack speed, +1 health per 1 armor[/p][p][/p][h1]Efficiency Optimization[/h1][p]Adjusted combat efficiency and improved frame rate in scenarios with a large number monsters and bullets.[/p][p][/p][h1]Adjustments[/h1][p]1. Adjusted the balance of Survival Mode[/p][p]2. Adjusted healing sound effects and their volume[/p][p]3. Adjusted the volume of monster dash sound effects[/p][p]4. Added descriptions for the feature of the item 【Golden Toad】 taking effect in real-time with the number of crystals[/p][p]5. Adjusted monster charge-up sound effects[/p][p]6. Adjusted the volume of the sound effects for the weapon 【High-Speed Rifle】[/p][p]7. Adjusted the rules and logic of bullet bounce and penetration. Now when both bounce and penetration coexist, bullets will first bounce and then penetrate[/p][p]8. The item 【Hunter Badge】 has been adjusted to: 33% chance to obtain 1 crystal when "killing" → "critically killing" a monster[/p][p]9. Adjusted the balance configuration of chest monsters in Normal Mode and Survival Mode[/p][p]10. Adjusted the descriptions of damage bonuses from percentage attributes such as evasion and speed for some weapons[/p][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][p]1. Fixed the issue where the pickup sound effect might be delayed or not play when picking up crystals[/p][p]2. Fixed the abnormal UI highlighting issue in the leaderboard interface[/p][p]3. Fixed the issue where landmines might overlap[/p][p]4. Fixed the issue where when the character 【Little Devil】 obtains an item with the attribute of reducing maximum health from a chest, if the character's maximum health is too low, it would cause an immediate game failure[/p][p]5. Fixed the abnormal display issue of the weapon slot when selecting the character 【Big Guy】 in the character selection interface[/p][p]6. Fixed the issue where the damage value of the weapon 【Golden Cudgel】 displays inconsistently in the shop and after purchase[/p][p]7. Fixed the issue where the same player has two rankings in the leaderboard[/p][p]8. Fixed the issue where using the character 【Merchant】 to enter combat in Survival Mode causes an error[/p][p]9. Fixed the issue of abnormal prices of items in the shop[/p][p]10. Fixed the issue of abnormal behavior of some monsters[/p]

notes.title: Changelog & Bundle Release - July 17, 2025
notes.content:
[h1]Adjustments[/h1][p]The unlock condition for DLC characters has been adjusted: they will be unlocked directly upon purchase, no longer requiring the completion of in-game achievements. [/p][p][/p][h1]Bundle Release[/h1][p]Hello, Supercats!
On July 15, we launched the "Supercat Squad" DLC, featuring 3 new Supercats: Nezha, Monk Tang, and Wukong. We have now created a bundle that includes both the base game and this DLC, with the bundle launching at a [b]30% discount[/b]![/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56289/__DLC/"][/dynamiclink]
This ensures that [b]both the base game and the DLC will remain discounted[/b], and the bundle will be priced lower than the base game—making it a great deal to buy at any time.[/p][p]
Additionally, we’ve simplified the unlocking method for the new characters in the DLC. Now, once you purchase the DLC, you can directly use Nezha, Monk Tang, and Wukong in-game—no need to unlock them by completing specific achievements anymore. We hope you enjoy playing![/p][p]
If you encounter any bugs in the new version or have suggestions, please join our community to share your feedback. Thank you for your support! Meow~[/p]

notes.title: New Version Update: New Mode + New Supercats + New DLC + Survival Leaderboard!
notes.content:
[h1]New Survival Mode[/h1]
New [b]Survival Mode[/b] - Season 1 Added. Each season lasts [b]3 weeks[/b]. In this new mode, there are only [b]10 waves[/b] of battles. The 10th wave unlocks the survival challenge, with unlimited battle time. However, monsters will gradually grow stronger over time, and bosses will spawn at regular intervals. Supercats must rely on weapons and items accumulated in the first 9 waves to strive for longer survival in the 10th wave’s survival challenge. Survival duration will be recorded in the seasonal leaderboard! Let’s see who the strongest Supercat Survivor is!
[previewyoutube=XGZpJuLRQzA;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/5c792f2492caa0f293b9946bc414d71b94be0d55.png[/img]
[h3]How to Unlock Suvival Mode[/h3]
Complete 3 clear runs on any difficulty (clearing 20 waves counts as one clear run) to unlock Survival Mode!
[h3]Seasonal Surprise Heroes[/h3]
Each season features 3 seasonal heroes, who receive additional trait bonuses (does not affect the normal mode). The 3 seasonal heroes for this season are 【Sniper】, 【Boxer】, and 【Magician】.
[h3]Seasonal Enhanced Items[/h3]
Each season includes 3 seasonal enhanced items, with some of their attributes strengthened (does not affect the normal mode). The 3 enhanced items for this season are 【Mob】, 【Cat Mask】, and 【Liquor】.
[h3]Seasonal Buff[/h3]
Each season has 1 seasonal buff that applies to all characters in Survival Mode.

[h1]New Survival Leaderboard[/h1]
New Survival Leaderboard - Season 1 Added. The leaderboard is synchronized with Survival Mode seasons, displaying the survival duration rankings of all Supercats participating in Survival Mode. Come compete with other Supercats!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/250ca4794ea71b931879ff047b7073bea67eb255.png[/img]

[h1]New Map[/h1]
A new exclusive map for Survival Mode has been added.

[h1]New Supercats[/h1]
5 new Supercats added for free - the ranks of Supercat warriors keep growing!
New Supercat: 【[b]Doctor[/b]】
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/dfc67ee98f26719645218af870bc3f02de29abd1.png[/img]
New Supercat: 【[b]Scholar[/b]】
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/44714fc52be3688cdd80f9f0694fd3fc37859838.png[/img]
New Supercat: 【[b]Wild Beast[/b]】

[h1]New Character DLC[/h1]
The first Supercat character DLC - Supercat Support Team, featuring 3 Journey to the West-themed Supercats: 【Nezha】, 【Monk Tang】, and 【Wukong】. Immortal aura arrives - get ready to join the survival challenge!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3748500/_/"][/dynamiclink]

[h1]New Weapons[/h1]
[b]Charging Gun[/b]
Melee Weapon: Key feature - gains 3000%/3500%/4000%/5000% damage bonus based on speed; -10%/-15%/-20%/-25% damage when standing still. We’d call this the "Rampaging Cat Car Style"!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/eccae1b28d6be435818b1b4e537ebc0dca9d1131.png[/img]


[b]Golden Cudgel[/b]
Melee Weapon: Key feature - gains 5000%/6500%/9000%/12500% damage bonus based on evasion. Best paired with - DLC Supercat Wukong!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/6853a0eb245cef134cefa5e754e77aa1089b35e9.png[/img]

[h1]Other New Additions[/h1]
1.Added [b]Steam Cloud[/b] support.
2.Added 36 new achievements, with in-game achievements synced with Steam achievements.
3.Added community entries in the main menu interface.

[h1]Balance Adjustments[/h1]
1.Reduced the health, damage, and speed of monsters in difficulties 2-6.
2.Increased the maximum value limit of the 【Life Steal】 attribute, with a maximum of 10 points healed per second.
3.The 【Vampire Bat】 item has added the trait of "taking 1 damage per second".

[h1]Art Performance Adjustments[/h1]
Adjustments to art performance focus on two aspects: ① Fine-tuning color presentation in battle scenes to enhance the recognizability of Supercat characters—preventing maps, monsters, bullet trajectories, and effects from being overly bright (which would distract from the battle focus) and reducing visual fatigue from long play sessions; ② Improving UI interaction usability to make various states in UI interactions clearer.
1.Reorganized and adjusted material textures of Supercats and monsters to highlight Supercats in battles.
2.Adjusted effects such as burning, lightning, and magic weapon attacks.
3.Monster-dropped coins are now blue crystals.
4.Re-baked map scenes to improve brightness.
5.Adjusted button interaction effects for clearer feedback.
6.Adjusted UI selection state presentation.
7.Fine-tuned the overall layout of all UI elements.

[h1]Optimization Adjustments[/h1]
1.Reduced the volume of the 【Long-Range Rifle】 weapon.
2.Adjusted the size of some fonts in the achievements interface to avoid overlap.
3.Bullets now destroy when colliding with map boundaries.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
1.Fixed the issue where keyboard controls couldn’t switch from the weapon slot to the refresh button when the shop interface had no items.
2.Fixed the text display issue with the 【Prophet】 item.
3.Fixed the issue where the 【Engine Oil】 item didn’t show values in shop items.
4.Fixed the issue where the 【Mob】 item didn’t activate after defeating monsters with the 【Cat Rocket Launcher】 weapon.
5.Fixed the value error of the 【Long-Range Rifle】 weapon.
6.Fixed the issue where items that had reached their acquisition limit could still be randomly generated.
7.Fixed the audio glitch caused by the failure retry panel popping up.
8.Fixed the issue where the health bar would automatically refill at the moment a Supercat was defeated.
9.Fixed the abnormal movement of some bosses.
10.Fixed the abnormal selection state of the weapon details panel.
11.Fixed the bullet count error of the orange-rarity 【Shotgun】 weapon.
12.Fixed the issue where the cooldown of the 【Tool Hammer】 weapon didn’t decrease after obtaining the 【Engine Oil】 item.
13.Fixed several multilingual translation errors in achievement descriptions.
14.Fixed various minor bugs.

notes.title: 【Update Preview】Survival Challenge Mode + Seasonal Leaderboard Coming Soon!
notes.content: [p]Hello, Supercats! Recently, we've been hard at work fixing bugs and developing new content. Many issues will be resolved in the next update, along with the launch of a new mode and seasonal leaderboard gameplay! Thank you all for reporting the issues and for your support![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3415300/_/"][/dynamiclink]We hope you're still dedicated to defending Meow Star. In the meantime, we’re fully focused on developing a new mode: Survival Challenge Mode. Paired with this mode will be a seasonal leaderboard, which will record and rank your survival time in the Survival Challenge. You'll be able to see who's at the top of the list when it comes to saving Meow Star![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/f0cf04fd2e7627ae5253ceceb73f141dc85a9c00.png"][/img]The Survival Challenge Mode is still in development, but here’s a sneak peek at the general gameplay~ The first 9 waves of the Survival Challenge are similar to the normal mode, designed to be easier and more exciting. However, starting from the 10th wave, the survival timer begins: the shop will no longer appear, monster stats will gradually strengthen over time, and Bosses will spawn periodically until you’re defeated. In such harsh conditions, Supercats can only rely on the weapons and items accumulated in the first 9 waves to fight through the horde! Your survival duration in the Survival Challenge Mode will be recorded on the seasonal leaderboard.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/8d34fc2fe1815629e2d1787cb646ab769c6d8094.png"][/img]Each season, 3 Supercats will receive enhancements (without affecting the normal mode) and gain extra traits. They’ll become the main force in seasonal battles![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/668498dbd2e1abbad367fa50a0c00711ae2b9865.png"][/img][/p][p]Similarly, 3 items will receive stat boosts (also without affecting the normal mode) to help Supercats survive longer in combat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/f5d17f6f613708c424936df2bc83364af0523536.png"][/img][/p][p]Each season’s Survival Challenge Mode will also have a global buff that benefits all Supercats equally. Who knows—will we introduce debuffs in the future? Heh heh heh~[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479591/83a74ad6ce236b97fcc8c3cbc5530d3908faf9b8.png"][/img][/p][p]Feel free to keep pushing us forward![/p]

notes.content: [h2]New Content[/h2][p]Added Steam Achievements.[/p][p][/p][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][p]1.Adjusted the penetration damage of the Energy Storage Blaster: from -100% to -80%.[/p][p]2.Adjusted the burn stacking mechanism: no stacking from the same source, stacking from different sources.[/p][p]3.Monsters will delay their first skill release by 2 seconds after spawning.[/p][p]4.Removed the "-100% Speed Growth Modification" attribute from Supercat "Big Mouth".[/p][p]5.Reduced the movement speed of Elite Turtle monsters.[/p][p]6.In all difficulty levels, monster count from Wave 5 onward is reduced by 20%, and damage growth is decreased by 20%.[/p][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][p]1.Adjusted the display effects of monsters, weapons, and projectiles for clearer visuals.[/p][p]2.Added information about elite monsters and enemy groups to the pause interface.[/p][p]3.When armor stats are negative, Supercats take increased damage.[/p][p]4.Adjusted the text descriptions of some items.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p]1.Fixed a bug where the coin convert ratio for Supercat "Ghost" was incorrect upon Results interface.[/p][p]2.Fixed a bug where item "Drink" did not affect treasure chests.[/p][p]3.Fixed a bug where damage growth modification attributes had no effect on item traits.[/p][p]4.Fixed a bug where burn damage would always crit when critical hit rate was 20%.[/p][p]5.Fixed a potential crash in the Results interface.[/p][p]6.Fixed a bug where rapid actions could cause repeated talent acquisitions during upgrades.[/p][p]7.Fixed several UI issues in the Results interface.[/p][p][/p][p]WELCOME TO JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER: [url="https://discord.gg/q5u3USXR" style="button"]JOIN US[/url][/p]
